title: Innokin Coolfire Z60 Zlide Vape Kit
description: The Innokin Coolfire Z60 Zlide Top Kit is the ultimate device for vaping enthusiasts, especially those who relish sub-ohm vaping. The award-winning combo of Coolfire Z60 mod and Zlide Top Fill tank offers the ideal combination of performance, power and longevity to your fingertips, pushing the boundaries of your vaping experience to the next level. Engineered for versatility, the device delivers up to 60W of fully adjustable power. The adjustable airflow system offers a personalized vaping experience, allowing you to tailor each puff to your liking. But the customization doesn't stop there. The Coolfire Z60 Zlide Top Kit is equipped with an easy-to-read OLED colour display , where you can manage your device settings with ease. Longevity meets functionality in this device. With a beefy 2500mAh battery , it is designed to keep up with your all-day vaping needs. Bid goodbye to the anxiety of running out of charge, and step into a worry-free vaping experience. The device further integrates a battery master switch to help extend both your coil and battery life as well as preventing misfires. The Z60 Zlide Top Kit isn't just about performance and longevity, it's also designed with convenience in mind. The kit features a top airflow system for better control over your draw and an easy sliding top-fill tank design to eliminate the hassle and mess of refills. This intuitive design ensures a clean, straightforward refill process, allowing you to enjoy your vaping session uninterrupted. The device is compatible with Z-coils , which feature DuoPrime mesh technology which helps vaporise e-liquid faster while spreading the liquid more evenly over the wicking material, which prolongs the life of the coil and delivers a richer flavour. Discover the superior performance and convenience of the Innokin Coolfire Z60 Zlide Top Kit. This is a vaping device designed for those who value quality, durability, and a user-friendly experience. Try the Z60 Zlide Top Kit today and elevate your vaping to a whole new level. We recommend using 70% and higher VG E-liquid with this kit. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
